questions.question_text: Can you introduce yourself and briefly describe your technical background?
questions.candidate_answer: I recently completed my MCA and have a background in software development. I have worked with Python, JavaScript, React, Node.js and databases. I am interested in backend development and enjoy solving technical problems and learning new technologies.

questions.question_text: Tell me about a time when you worked as part of a team on a project.
questions.candidate_answer: During my academic project, I worked as part of a team where we divided the work into different modules. I was responsible for development-related tasks and coordinated with other team members when integrating the modules. We discussed issues regularly and worked together to complete the project on time.

questions.question_text: What are your career goals for the next few years?
questions.candidate_answer: My goal is to build strong technical expertise and become a reliable software professional. I want to improve my development skills, work on real-world projects and gradually take more responsibility. I also want to keep learning new technologies that are useful for my role.

questions.question_text: Are you comfortable with the job location, working hours and availability requirements of this position?
questions.candidate_answer: Yes, I am comfortable with the job requirements and working schedule. I am willing to adapt to the organization's working environment and can manage my time according to the responsibilities of the role.
